definitions.explanation: The galaxy containing our solar system, appearing as a faint band of light stretching across the night sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、{天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: On the night of Tanabata, I saw the Milky Way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: In the countryside, you can see the Milky Way clearly.
The Milky Way contains hundreds of billions of stars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{織姫|おりひめ}→織姫：25130_orihime⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{彦星|ひこぼし}→彦星：26047_hikoboshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: In the Tanabata legend, Orihime and Hikoboshi cross the Milky Way to meet once a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街灯|がいとう}→街灯：14025_gaitou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{山奥|やまおく}→山奥：12438_yamaoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かりながら→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧{天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Soaking in an outdoor hot spring deep in the mountains with no streetlights, gazing at the Milky Way — that's the ultimate luxury.

notes:
{天|あま}の{川|がわ} literally means 'River of Heaven,' the Japanese name for the Milky Way.

TANABATA LEGEND (⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧):
In the famous legend, ⟦{織姫|おりひめ}→織姫：25130_orihime⟧ (Vega) and ⟦{彦星|ひこぼし}→彦星：26047_hikoboshi⟧ (Altair) are lovers separated by the {天|あま}の{川|がわ}, allowed to meet only once a year on July 7th when magpies form a bridge across the celestial river.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: can see the Milky Way
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross the Milky Way
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仰|あお}ぐ→仰ぐ：11454_aogu⟧: to look up at the Milky Way

SCIENTIFIC TERMS:
- ⟦{銀河|ぎんが}→銀河：05051_ginga⟧: galaxy (general term)
- ⟦{銀河系|ぎんがけい}→銀河系：25705_gingakei⟧: the Milky Way galaxy (scientific)
- {天の川銀河|あまのがわぎんが}: Milky Way Galaxy

BEST VIEWING:
- Summer months in Japan
- Away from city lights (⟦{光害|こうがい}→光害：noentry⟧)
